get.description: Get search suggestions for annual fee ranges, benefits, and popular banks
Return bounded, anonymous-safe card, bank, and category typeahead results.

OpenApi3 schema for this API. Format can be selected via content negotiation.

- YAML: application/vnd.oai.openapi
- JSON: application/vnd.oai.openapi+json

BankList.description: Lightweight serializer for Bank list views.

CreditCardFieldHistory.description: Serializer for CreditCard field history entries.

CreditCardList.description:
Serializer for CreditCard list views.

Includes the bank identity and the detail fields the frontend transforms
and renders (reward policy, additional features, waiver policy and fee
strings), while preserving the existing bank_name field.
